_texts.01-hook: Agents now pay agents. But who should they trust?
_texts.02-fresh: A bad agent loses its case on Internet Court... then comes back with a brand-new wallet, and a clean record.
_texts.03-link: AgentScore follows the owner, not the wallet. Nansen finds the link, and the chain proves it.
_texts.04-validators: GenLayer validators check every ruling and every link, and must agree before anything is stored.
_texts.05-product: This is the live report for that new wallet. Grade D: pay only through escrow, because it inherits the old wallet's loss.
_texts.06-api: Any agent can ask first, with one call, over REST or MCP.
_texts.07-cta: AgentScore. Check the agent, before you pay it.
